$comment: The leaves' look (docs/WORK_QUEUE.md item 5, the Leaf Lab's option 5 at its defaults; owner, 2026-11-11: "#5 looks really good with defaults"; docs/TREE_GROWTH.md §10). blocks: the blocks drawn this way, by name (leaves stay blocks; nothing on the wire). canopyBlend: how far (0 none, 1 all) a leaf face's lighting normal leans from its face toward the crown's outward direction, away from the centroid of the leaf cells within 3 m of the point (the same reach each way, so neighbouring chunks agree), so a crown shades as one rounded mass (the Lab fitted an ellipsoid to each tree; the mesher has no tree record). chamfer: how far (cells; a cell is 1 m across and ½ m tall, so 0.28 m across and 0.14 m up) a leaf cell's edges and corners are cut back where both faces meeting there are exposed (no leaf beside them); cells inside the crown stay full cubes, and the face between two leaf cells is filled where one is cut back and the other not, so a chamfer's end shows no gap. cards (the Lab's leaf cards; owner: "Cards could only show on near trees"): painted leaf clumps, alpha-cut quads standing off exposed leaf faces, facing out of the crown: density (cards per exposed face, scaled per face: tops 2.6×, sides 2.2× by their area, bottoms 1.2×), sizeM (a card's width, ±25 %), swayM (how far the wind moves a card's corners), and fadeStartM to fadeEndM, over which they dissolve with distance (none past it); never meshed on a CPU adapter (the cheapest tier). Run `node shared/look/leaves.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-look/src/leaves.gen.rs is stale.
